history.summary: 99yr leasehold 1,087sqft 3BR at The Astor, D14 Kembangan/Frankel area, at $1.42M / $1,306 PSF — an affordable, liquid-band 3BR with a strong 5.63%/yr resale CAGR and the only on_frontier=true entry in the batch. The sub-$1.5M price for a full 3BR in D14 is the core attraction.
history.rating_rationale: Best risk/reward in the batch: 5.63%/yr resale-only CAGR (above RCR baseline), top score_1000 (585), highest Elo (1254) and on_frontier=true. $1,306 PSF is ~5% above the $1,244 median but the absolute $1.42M for a 3BR sits in a very deep buyer-pool band attractive to HDB upgraders. Caveats: 16-txn series is moderate, 99yr LH from 2006, and 960m to Kembangan MRT. The combination of low entry, solid appreciation and broad appeal warrants a Buy.
catalysts: Sub-$1.5M full 3BR in D14 — deep HDB-upgrader demand and broad resale pool

history.summary: 99-yr D14 3BR (1,087sqft, 2006) priced mid-range within its own recent transactions — at market, not the bargain the -20.2% age_adj_premium implies. Decent RCR region, near Kembangan MRT, but no value cushion.
history.rating_rationale: Astor's recent 12-month transactions run $1,161-1,380 psf (avg ~$1,252, high $1,380 in Mar 2025). This unit asks $1,306 psf — mid-to-upper within that band, i.e. fairly priced, not cheap. The dossier's -20.2% age_adj_premium overstates the discount (16 appreciation txns and only 5 cohort txns are on the thin side), so I weight the verified transaction band over the model. Positives are real: a roomy 1,087sqft 3BR, D14 (RCR, ~+3.5% realized fwd), boutique 55-unit project near Kembangan EW MRT. But with no value margin, a 2006 lease (~79yrs left) and a small/illiquid development, it's a hold-rate name rather than an outperformer.

Boutique 55-unit, 99-yr (~79yrs left) — thinner liquidity and gradual lease decay
catalysts: D14 RCR (realized fwd region ~+3.5%), near Kembangan MRT (EW) with Kaki Bukit DTL nearby
Paya Lebar/Geylang regeneration spillover over a 5-7yr horizon
